name: Lansing Parks and Recreation summer and part time jobs
org: City of Lansing Parks and Recreation
what_you_do: Work part time or in summer for the city's parks. Teen jobs include umpire or scorekeeper for youth sports, tennis teacher, inflatables staff and lifeguard.
who_can_apply: Umpires and scorekeepers can be 14 and up. Tennis teachers, inflatables staff and lifeguards can be 16 and up. Camp counselors, after school leaders, teen leaders and building staff must be 18.
pay_detail: Paid. The parks page does not state the pay.
duration: Part time and seasonal. Most hiring is for the summer months.
deadline_text: The page says most summer jobs post in February. 2027 summer jobs are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Look for the job on the City of Lansing Career Portal at governmentjobs.com and apply online. For lifeguard jobs, the page says to check the YMCA job listings. Questions: Human Resources at 517-483-4004.
notes: The city's seasonal jobs page lists short term jobs. They include activity leaders, golf attendants, lifeguards and head lifeguards, sports officials and tennis teachers. In Michigan most workers under 18 need a work permit. You get it through your school.
